title: A Dual-Expert Strategy Integrating LLMs to Mitigate Negative Transfer in Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2608.23131v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation (CDSR) predicts the next item a user will interact with based on their historical interaction sequences across multiple domains. Recent approaches leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) finetuned on textual representations of cross-domain user sequences to retrieve the recommended items, referred to as LLMRec. However, LLMRec primarily models the autoregressive patterns of token-level item texts, while overlooking item-level collaborative signals. This semantic misalignment often leads to distorted knowledge transfer across domains-termed negative transfer degrading performance in the CDSR task. To address this issue, we propose a novel LLM-based CDSR model, DuELRec: Domain-Gated Dual Experts with LLMs for Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation. translated_title: 一种整合大语言模型的双专家策略以缓解跨域序列推荐中的负迁移
translated_abstract: 跨域序列推荐（CDSR）根据用户跨多个领域的历史交互序列预测其下一步将交互的物品。近期方法利用在跨域用户序列的文本表示上微调的大语言模型（LLMs）来检索推荐物品，称为LLMRec。然而，LLMRec主要建模词元级物品文本的自回归模式，而忽略了物品级协同信号。这种语义错位常导致跨域知识迁移失真——即负迁移，从而降低CDSR任务的性能。为解决此问题，我们提出一种新颖的基于LLM的CDSR模型，即DuELRec：用于跨域序列推荐的领域门控双专家与LLMs。我们提出一个领域门控双专家框架，配备物品感知注意力转换模块，将文本子词元聚合成物品级表示。
tldr: 本文提出一种领域门控双专家框架（DuELRec），通过结合物品级协同信号与LLM文本建模，有效缓解跨域序列推荐中的负迁移问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a domain-gated dual-expert framework (DuELRec) that integrates item-level collaborative signals with LLM text modeling to effectively mitigate negative transfer in cross-domain sequential recommendation.
